up: For the assay with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL4649965', retrieve all exact activity measurements (those with standard_relation = '='). Include the activity details: activity ID, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, pchembl value. Also include the compound's ChEMBL ID, preferred name (if available), and canonical SMILES. Only include activities where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Do not restrict the activity type; include all available standard types. Ensure the output contains one row per activity record.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.pchembl_value, md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649965' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
